message:
As we navigate the ups and downs of family life, it’s important to remember that preparedness isn’t just about us adults—it’s also about engaging our kids in a way that feels empowering and fun. The resources from Ready.gov can help us teach our children about safety in a way that resonates with them, fostering a sense of responsibility and awareness.

When we include our kids in conversations about preparedness, we’re not only equipping them with knowledge, but also creating opportunities for connection and teamwork. It’s a chance to turn a serious topic into something meaningful that we can all share together. 

So, how can we make learning about safety a family affair? 🏡
